children: YHN Acquisition I entered into an amendment to its Investment Management Trust Agreement to extend the deadline for liquidating its IPO trust account in three optional three-month increments, up to June 19, 2027. Each extension requires a $100,000 deposit into the trust account. The change provides added time and flexibility for the SPAC to complete a business combination.
: Amendment to Investment Management Trust Agreement
